The 'smudging' suggests a generative failure in rendering fine mechanical details, which is a structural artifact rather than just texture. I am upgrading the hinge artifact severity to 2.0 (noticeable structural softness) and keeping text gibberish at 1.5 (common AI artifact, less critical for object identity).
